item.title: CISA adds Ivanti Connect Secure flaws CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to KEV after active exploit chaining
item.description:
Federal cybersecurity authorities have updated the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog under Binding Operational Directive 26-04, issuing emergency patch mandates for two Ivanti Connect Secure flaws actively chained in wild attack campaigns. Remote threat actors chain authentication missing handlers with predictable disk file upload bugs to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.
The KEV catalog additions feature Ivanti Connect Secure flaws CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527. Cyber threat intelligence reports confirm threat actors actively chain these flaws alongside previously disclosed authentication bypass zero day CVE-2026-104935. Unauthenticated remote adversaries transmit crafted HTTP requests to write malicious payloads to known disk locations, elevating local user permissions to full root control on target gateways. Affected software builds include versions prior to 25.1.1.3 and 22.8R2.6.
Subverting secure remote access gateways exposes single sign-on user sessions and internal enterprise networks. Because Ivanti Connect Secure appliances manage remote SSL VPN access, an unauthenticated root takeover permits threat actors to deploy web shell backdoors, capture user credentials, and move laterally across production subnets.
- Upgrade Ivanti Connect Secure appliances immediately to fixed release builds 25.1.1.3 or 22.8R2.6. - Execute the official Ivanti Integrity Checking Tool ICT to inspect local appliance filesystems for unauthorized web shells or implants. - Restrict public internet routing to Ivanti management portals, placing management controls on isolated VLANs. - Invalidate active SSL VPN user session tokens and enforce mandatory credential rotations across administrative accounts.
Perimeter access controller defense requires rapid patch deployment and mandatory integrity checking to ensure remote access gateways remain completely protected from unauthenticated root exploit chains. #CodeDefence #Ivanti #ConnectSecure #AuthBypass #RCE #CISA #KEV #NetworkSecurity #AppSec #PatchManagement

item.title: Chainalysis discloses internal system breach resulting from offensive AI agentic techniques
item.description:
Blockchain analytics platform maintainers have published security incident notifications detailing an intrusion into internal infrastructure. External adversaries utilized automated agentic artificial intelligence frameworks to gain unauthorized access to internal systems and exfiltrate user identity records.
The security incident impacted internal customer identity tools at Chainalysis. Forensic investigations confirmed external adversaries deployed offensive agentic AI capabilities to scan, locate, and access internal database stores without authorization. Exfiltrated records contain platform user IDs, full names, corporate email addresses, and organizational role tags. Company disclosures confirm that core investigation content, session tokens, and authentication credentials remained unaffected.
Subverting cloud identity stores via offensive AI agentic techniques highlights the accelerating speed of automated intrusion toolkits. As adversaries leverage autonomous AI agents to automate reconnaissance and exploit execution, security teams face compressed containment windows and heightened phishing exposure across impacted enterprise personnel.
- Enforce mandatory two-factor authentication 2FA using hardware security keys across all platform user accounts. - Inspect enterprise identity monitoring systems for unverified password reset requests or suspicious login prompts. - Implement strict egress filtering and behavioral rate-limiting across cloud API endpoints handling customer identity data. - Educate organization personnel to recognize social engineering and recruitment scams impersonating analytics platform staff.
Cloud platform governance demands rigid access boundaries and continuous behavioral monitoring to ensure corporate identity repositories remain insulated from autonomous AI agent exploitation campaigns. #CodeDefence #Chainalysis #AISecurity #AgenticAI #DataBreach #IdentitySecurity #CloudSecurity #AppSec
